answer.new_information: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that 47 machine centers would be added in Wuxi, China for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks. The company says 100% of the new capacity is pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards (company claim, no award values given). It targets US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026 (a company target, not a result). Separately, Yahoo reports NN's removal from the Russell Microcap Value Index in late June 2026. The projections of US$485.5m revenue and US$47.9m earnings by 2028 come from a Simply Wall St style narrative, and the US$489.5m and US$48.3m figures come from unnamed analysts (rumour tier). Neither projection is a company figure, and their period and definition are not matched to any stored question.
